# Training Industry

> Training Industry is the leading resource for L&D professionals, offering certifications, research, vendor directory, and community for corporate training leaders.

Training Industry provides comprehensive support for learning and development professionals through certifications like CPTM, research reports, a vendor directory of thousands of training providers, and publications including Training Industry Magazine. The organization serves as a central hub for corporate training strategy, best practices, and industry intelligence.

## Key Topics

- L&D (Learning & Development)
- CPTM (Certified Professional in Training Management)
- Training Industry Magazine
- Corporate Training
- Training Industry Conference & Expo (TICE)
- LMS (Learning Management Systems)
- AI in Training
- Leadership Development
- Training Management
- OPTIC Framework
- Professional Development
- Learning Technologies
- Training Industry Research
- Tia (AI Agent)
- Training Industry Senior Leaders Program

## Professional Development & Certifications

- [Certified Professional in Training Management (CPTM™)](https://trainingindustry.com/continuing-professional-development/certified-professional-in-training-management): CPTM credential program for training managers and L&D professionals
- [Training Manager Courses: Programs For L&D Professionals](https://trainingindustry.com/continuing-professional-development): L&D courses including CPTM, Senior Leaders Program, and AI Essentials
- [Training Industry Store — L&D Courses, Events, Research & More](https://store.trainingindustry.com): Main store for CPTM certifications, TICE conference, L&D courses and training resources

## Community & Membership

- [Training Industry Membership](https://trainingindustry.com/become-a-training-industry-member): Membership program with AI agent Tia, community access, and exclusive discounts
- [Subscribe to Training Industry Emails - Training Industry](https://trainingindustry.com/subscribe): Email newsletter subscription for L&D topics, webinars, and industry news
- [Collaborate With Training Industry](https://trainingindustry.com/collaborate-with-us): Collaboration and partnership opportunities for content contributors and speakers

## Research & Industry Intelligence

- [About Training Industry Research](https://trainingindustry.com/research-about): Overview of Training Industry Research's data-driven analysis and best practices
- [Top Training Companies - Training Industry](https://trainingindustry.com/top-training-companies): Top 20 Training Companies rankings and Watch List reports for L&D vendors
- [The Corporate Training Landscape - Training Industry](https://trainingindustry.com/corporate-training-landscape): Corporate Training Landscape Map identifying 21 key training market sectors
